sum: Murano Global Investments Plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate business in Mexico. The company owns, develops, manages, and operates hotel and resort properties. It is also involved in the execution, construction, management, and operation of various industrial, business, and tourism real estate projects. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
ceo: Mr. Elias Sacal Cababie (Chairman of the Board & CEO)
